test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who has taken over as President of Financial Action Task Force in July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__T Raja Kumar__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The global agency responsible for monitoring money laundering and terrorism financing is the **Financial Action Task Force (FATF).**
 
• It establishes worldwide norms with the intention of stopping these** criminal activities** and the damage they do to society.
 
• **T Raja Kumar**, a Singaporean of Indian descent, was named the new **president** of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) on 1st July 2022.
 
• The FATF stated that the new president would** prioritize increasing asset recovery**, as well as the efficiency of international **anti-money laundering** and counter-terrorism funding measures.
 
• Earlier, he **served as** the **Ministry's Deputy Secretary (International)** from January 2015 to July 2021 and the Home Team Academy's Chief Executive from 2014 to 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanjiv Kapoor: **CEO-designate, Jet Airways. Former President, Oberoi Hotels & Resorts; Former Chief Strategy and Commercial Officer, Vistara and Former COO, SpiceJet.
 
• **Ashwani Bhatia:** Whole Time Member, SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India).
 
• **Mahesh Verma:** Chairperson of NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare Providers).
